app.name: Arya Vysya Vamsha Vruksham
app.tagline: The verified family tree of the Arya Vysya community
app.footer: Maintained with the district in-charges, local sanghas & sabhas and state Mahasabhas · Om Sri Vasavi Kanyaka Parameswari Namaha

home.heroTitle: Preserve your family's vamsham for generations
home.heroBody: Record your ancestors, gotra, family name and native place. Every member is endorsed by their local sangha or sabha and verified by the district in-charge, and each family keeps its own branch accurate.
home.step1Body: Create an account and tell us your family details and district.
home.step2Body: Your local sangha / sabha endorses you, and the district in-charge confirms you belong to the family and links you to the tree.
home.step3Body: Edit your own family up to 5 generations above and below you.
home.pendingNotice: Your membership is waiting for verification by the {district} district in-charge.

marriage.alreadyProposed: This marriage link is already waiting for the other family to accept.
marriage.blocked_lineal: Not allowed: one of them is the other's ancestor.
marriage.blocked_siblings: Not allowed: they are brother and sister (common parent {name}).
marriage.blocked_parallelCousins: Not allowed: children of two brothers or two sisters count as siblings (common grandparent {name}).
marriage.incoming: {by} has proposed a marriage link with {name} from another family. It joins the two family charts once this side accepts.
marriage.outgoing: Marriage link with {name} is waiting for their family (or their district in-charge) to accept.
marriage.checkHint: Customs differ between families, so these are shown rather than forbidden. Your confirmation is recorded in the audit log.
marriage.flag_menarikam: Cross-cousin marriage – children of a brother and a sister.

marriage.requestsHint: Another family has linked one of your people as a spouse. Nothing joins the charts until you accept.
marriage.flag_maternalGotra: One side's gotra is the other's mother's gotra.
marriage.blocked_sagotra: Not allowed in this region: same gotra (sagotra).
marriage.blocked_maternalGotra: Not allowed in this region: one side's gotra is the other's mother's gotra.
marriage.blocked_menarikam: Not allowed in this region: cross-cousin marriage.

rules.intro: Marriage customs differ between regions. Choose for each check whether it is allowed, shown as a warning the member must confirm (recorded in the audit log), or blocked. A state without its own row uses the default. When the two families are in states with different rules, the stricter one applies. Marrying an ancestor, a sibling or a parallel cousin is always blocked.
rules.note: Confirm these with the state Mahasabhas before relying on them.
